text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Here comes Espoir City! It's Espoir City!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah――!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Still, guess it just wasn't your cup of 
tea, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
—Because I wasn't able to raise you to the 
level you're at now.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (Yeah, you're damn right. Shitty old man.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That's why it's your choice to make, 
Espo."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "That's why you get to choose, Espo."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (True. I can totally choose both.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(Both "becoming stronger by accepting 
one's weakness" and "becoming stronger by 
refusing to accept it.")

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Then...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(I'll never acknowledge you as long as I 
live.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Get hyped, crowd! Every single one of you, 
watch me!! The me standing right in front 
of you is strong as hell!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
There's no way in hell I'd do something 
pathetic and weak! That's who Espoir City 
is!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "You can make yourself the right answer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘You can make yourself the right 
answer.’"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ORAAGHHH!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Even if her tough front was born out of 
anxiety."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her current strength is far from just 
putting on a brave face. Because she 
really is—"
choice_data_list: Because you're a strong Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: URAAAAAAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The February Stakes is decided! The winner 
is—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah... How's that!! How d'ya like that, 
huh?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this very day, she demonstrated her 
strength. Raising her fist, wearing a 
proud smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to get even a little closer to 
her, I run right along the outer rail.
choice_data_list:
(This is it! This running style is the 
real you—!)

(This is it! This running style is the 
real you—!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter what fears she fought behind the 
scenes, she would always crush that terror 
and anxiety through sheer willpower. —That 
was the kind of girl she was.
choice_data_list: There's no way you're a weak Umamusume!!

There's no way you could be a weak Uma 
Musume!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Looks like you get it after all.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'll stick with this until the day I die. 
Doesn't matter how strong anyone else 
gets.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna do things my own way, all the 
way to the very end!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod again and again at her words. There 
is no longer any hesitation in her vow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This is her path.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...That's why you gotta let me run in the 
Kashiwa Kinen.
choice_data_list: The Kashiwa Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: So, I wanna take on Furioso.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...So that I can clash against the 
strength she chose with the strength I've 
chosen for myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Kashiwa Kinen is a 1,600m dirt mile 
race held at Funabashi Racecourse in May.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And for Furioso, Funabashi is home turf. 
If we're going to challenge her as the 
away team, readiness and preparation are 
absolute musts.
choice_data_list:
Okay, if we're doing this, let's do it 
properly

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Thoroughly? What kind of thorough?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haha... You're telling me you already have 
a plan?
choice_data_list: Let's see—
That's right—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the February Stakes, I 
called Espoir City into the Trainer's 
office.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... The desk is a total mess. That 
stack of paper is insane.
choice_data_list:
Here's the data on your past personal best 
times.

Here's the data on the best times you've 
clocked in the past.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The stopwatches are organized by 
distance. For 1600m, 1200m, and the 2000m 
one too..."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ah... You're right.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hmm. And the 1,600m time is...
choice_data_list: Let's surpass this.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you want me to set the fastest 
1600m record...!
choice_data_list: No, that's not all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What we are about to throw down right now 
is—a letter of challenge to her very self.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After all, Espoir City herself had 
declared, "I'm going to stick to my own 
way."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? What does that mean...
choice_data_list:
Surpassing your past self should be a 
given, right?

Surpassing your past self is only natural, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I open the textbook and read aloud the 
newly created profile for the "Strongest 
Umamusume."
choice_data_list:
"For the strongest, their only enemy was 
always their own strength."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And once again, I lay out her records for 
every course and every split time right 
before her.
choice_data_list:
Let's beat our best times at every 
distance.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, are you stupid?! You gotta be 
stupid, right?! Total idiot, aren't you?! 
Have you lost your mind?!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I mean, the race is 1,600m, so...!
choice_data_list: Huh? Wait, maybe I can't do it...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I can do it, you know!!
choice_data_list: I figured, I think so too.
Right? I think so too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief. Mooooooo...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it. ...I'm gonna do it! Don't look 
down on me! Remember that!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —I'm a strong Umamusume, ya hear me?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, new training for the Kashiwa 
Kinen had begun!"
